description: SynapseBridge — DecodeLabs Project 4: Frontend & Backend Integration. A vanilla-JS SPA wired to an Express 5 + TypeScript + Zod 4 API, making every request visible as it crosses the bridge.
name: synapsebridge

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npx tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json
